comment: The demo's single source of truth (demo/SCRIPT.md in data). Seconds on the film clock; every cut on the 100 BPM grid (0.6 s). The composition, the caption sidecars, the cue mixer and the music bed all read this file; nothing retypes a time or a number. {NAME} in a caption is web/lib/copy.ts NAME: the honesty sentences live only there.

shots.comment: What demo/record.mjs filmed: real UI from web/out, reel sim seconds and playback speed. Files: web/public/demo/shots/<id>.mp4 (+ <id>.json with cursor events).

landings.comment: Frame contracts from demo/SCRIPT.md: film seconds where a reel moment is on screen.

captions.text: GossipSub v1.1 · run live · broken on purpose
50 peers · one publish · every hop drawn
five Sybils graft in and flood
pruned by score · two heartbeats · nobody coordinated it
nothing invalid, so P4 never fires · only P3, floored at −0.25
faults cleared · mesh healed in 1.4 s · delivery 100 %
real mainnet · slot 15466394 · 138 observers, in the order they saw the block
same mechanism, toy constants · D 6 · heartbeat 1 s · prune at −10

vo.text: Peer scoring is what keeps gossip alive under attack.
Luminar. Fifty simulated peers. GossipSub one point one.
Five Sybils graft in, and flood.
P4 scores the spam. Two heartbeats.
Now the quiet attack. Four silent peers eclipse node ten.
Nothing invalid. Scoring never fires. That is the limit, on screen.
Clear the faults. The mesh re-grafts in one point four seconds.
And the real network. Mainnet blocks, arriving at a hundred and thirty-eight observers.

cues.why: wordmark stamps on the open card
the one dissolve that sounds; later dissolves are silent
first publish establishes the message sound, then silence
five Sybils graft in (the phase card and the first attack links land here)
PRUNED: the thesis moment, the one big hit
the mainnet block wave lights the observers

music.comment: Mood per scene for demo/make-music.mjs; the bed starts at 0 and runs the film's length.
music.open: sparse, airy, a slow sub pulse
music.mesh: warm major, soft electric piano on the grid, light arpeggio
music.sybil: tension: minor, bass pulse on every beat, filter opening; only the sub bass during the air pocket 18.6–19.2, full release on 19.2
music.heal: bright, arpeggio returns, resolves to major
music.end: swell from 46.2, final chord rings out and ends with the last frame
